note: A1+ Unit 1 Lesson 1.6 rebuilt on 2026-11-12 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. A1 1.6 Parents and Grandparents names the father, mother, parents, grandfather and grandmother. A1+ 1.6 says how often Ana's parents and grandparents do something, with always, usually, sometimes and never before the verb: her grandmother always drinks tea, her grandfather never drinks tea (he drinks coffee), her mother usually runs in the park and her father sometimes runs in the park. Ana speaks about her family; Luis asks Who ...? (Ana and Sofia share one voice). Frequency cannot be photographed, so each photo shows who does what; the Listen text cards set the frequency words against each other (the answer is what was heard), and a never sentence is never set against a photo that does not contradict it. The grandparents keep their 1.4 look (A1+ 1.4 k04). The previous 1.6 (Ask about a routine: How often, studies) returns as 1.7, which follows A1 1.7. The user approved everything up to the Preview publish in advance ("everything approved until push to preview", 2026-11-12).

lesson.title: 1.6 How often my family does it
lesson.unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
lesson.lesson_title: How often my family does it
lesson.sub_lesson_title: How often my family does it
lesson.goal: Say how often your parents and grandparents do something, with always, usually, sometimes and never before the verb (My grandmother always drinks tea.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.6 Parents and Grandparents: the family words return with how often each person does something. The one new grammar relationship is the frequency word between the person and the verb (My grandmother always drinks tea.), on A1+ 1.2's he/she -s and 1.3's runs in the park.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 1.6 father, mother, grandfather, grandmother; A1 1.9 Who ...?; A1 2.1 park; A1 5 tea and coffee; A1 3.10 my; A1+ 1.2 drinks; A1+ 1.3 runs; A1+ 1.4 the grandparents.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Place the frequency word before the verb in one smooth sentence (My father sometimes runs in the park.), with a clear -s on the verb. Do not require native-like speed.
